canonical_fields.effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.)
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞ (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)

qa.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
qa.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
During an attack by this card, I used its [Your Turn] effect to digivolve it. Does this card's [End of Attack] inherited effect trigger at the end of the attack?

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Hybrid]/[Shambala]/[TS] trait: Cost 5

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Hybrid] Form.
